services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: SPACE Gallery and Space Annex offer distinctive Denver gallery event rental spaces designed for modern celebrations, meaningful gatherings, and creative events of all kinds. Located in Denver’s Art District, the venues provide contemporary settings surrounded by curated artwork, making them ideal spaces for weddings, receptions, and milestone moments. From Denver weddings and Colorado destination weddings to anniversaries, bridal showers, and wedding showers, SPACE Gallery and Space Annex create elevated yet welcoming atmospheres for couples seeking something beyond a traditional venue. The venues proudly host LGBTQ+ and queer weddings, ensuring every love story is celebrated authentically
